rules.statement: The prohibition in section 24 of the Interpretation Ordinance, as amended by the Interpretation (Amendment) Act No. 18 of 1972, does not bar granting an interim injunction against a Minister for acts done without jurisdiction, ultra vires, or in bad faith.
rules.supporting_quote: by the majority, Perera J., Vythialingam J., Ismail J., Weeraratne J., and Sharvananda J., (Pathirana J., Udalagama J., Gunesekera J., and Wijesundera J., dissenting) that the prohibition contained in section 24 of the Interpretation Ordinance introduced by the Interpretation (Amendment) Act No. 18 of 1972 does not apply to a case where an interim injunction was sought against a Minister in respect of any act done by him without jurisdiction, ultra vires or in bad faith. 2

meta.parties: Sirisena and Others v. Honourable.H.S.R.B. Kobbekaduwa,Minister of Agriculture and Lands
